purpose: Confirm the fixed native-mass target-transport method across remaining grouped folds before choosing a multi-seed candidate
control: Existing base checkpoints on identical grouped splits and thread settings
recipe: Unchanged first-fold transport; no auxiliary head or inference change
resources: One CPU trainer, nice15, hidden CUDA, existing RAM safeguards; use only stopped campaign service
selection: Evaluate all five folds; compare pooled scores, per-source rates and event tails. Reject a uniformly robust claim if source/rate regressions persist. No leaderboard forecast from CV alone.
